about: Manus AI develops general-purpose AI agents that autonomously complete multi-step tasks such as research, coding and report creation. Launched in 2025 by Butterfly Effect, a startup with Chinese founders that relocated to Singapore. Meta announced an acquisition of Manus in December 2025. Revenue comes from subscriptions for individuals and professionals. Crunchbase shows about $585 million in total funding, latest October 2026. Well-known in the AI community, limited mainstream consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Recursion
wiki.what: Process of repeating items in a self-similar way
wiki.text: Recursion occurs when the definition of a concept or process depends on a simpler or previous version of itself. Recursion is used in a variety of disciplines ranging from linguistics to logic. The most common application of recursion is in mathematics and computer science, where a function being defined is applied within its own definition. While this apparently defines an infinite number of instances, it is often done in such a way that no infinite loop or infinite chain of references can occur.

about: Rezolve is a London-based provider of AI-driven commerce technology, including Brain Commerce, which gives retailers AI search and product discovery, plus mobile commerce, payments and image recognition (Rezolve Brain and Rezolve Lens). Customers are retailers and brands, with revenue from software and services. Listed on Nasdaq as RZLV since 2024 after a SPAC merger with Armada Acquisition Corp I. Crunchbase shows about $665 million in funding. B2B brand with little consumer awareness.

Customers are carriers like Deutsche Telekom and software vendors, with revenue from platform fees and transactions. Founded in 2009 and based in San Francisco. about: San Francisco-based voice, video and text chat platform, founded 2015 as a gaming chat tool and now used by more than 200 million monthly users for communities and friends, earning from Nitro subscriptions, server boosts and ads. Privately held, valued around $15 billion; an IPO has been reported as planned. Strong consumer brand among young gamers and online communities. Discord's users send billions of messages monthly, and the company has about 1,000 employees.

wiki.title: Discord
wiki.text: Discord is an American instant messaging and VoIP social platform that allows communication through voice calls, video calls, text messaging, and media. Communication can be private or in virtual communities called "servers". A server is a collection of persistent chat rooms and voice channels accessed by invitation links. Discord runs on Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, iPadOS, Linux, and in web browsers.

about: Dubai-headquartered, Istanbul-founded marketing technology company, founded 2012, selling the Insider One platform for personalised customer journeys, CDP and AI to retailers, banks and telecoms in dozens of countries. Became a unicorn after 2022 funding led by Sequoia India and General Atlantic. B2B brand, with limited consumer awareness. The input lists AI and marketing among its industries, and it has offices in Europe, the Middle East and Asia.

wiki.title: Insider One
wiki.text: Insider One is a software as a service (SaaS) company that develops software for customer engagement and marketing automation.

about: Autonomous driving and delivery robots developer based in Austin, Texas, which spun out from Yandex's self-driving unit. Partners include Uber and Grubhub, and it has Nebius as a backer. Customers are ride-hailing and delivery platforms. Funding of about $850 million is shown. B2B with growing public awareness through robot deliveries. It runs sensors and vehicles in Texas and Europe, with Uber and Grubhub partners, and was backed by Nebius and Uber.

wiki.title: Avride
wiki.text: Avride Inc. is a developer of vehicular automation technology, including self-driving cars, robotaxis, and delivery robots. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas and has additional offices in Tel Aviv, Israel; Belgrade, Serbia and Seoul, South Korea. It is a subsidiary of Nebius Group. Uber and Uber Eats use its self-driving cars and delivery robots in a few cities.

about: San Francisco-based background check software company, founded 2014, providing screening for employers and gig platforms such as Uber and Instacart, with API-first products. Valued about $5 billion. B2B brand with moderate public awareness. Customers are employers, staffing firms and gig-economy platforms that pay per check. Employs several hundred staff. Little consumer awareness beyond applicants who are screened. Checkr claims to process millions of background checks and works with thousands of customers including Uber, Lyft and Instacart.

wiki.title: Fractal
wiki.text: In mathematics, a fractal is a geometric shape containing detailed structure at arbitrarily small scales, usually having a fractal dimension strictly exceeding the topological dimension. Many fractals appear similar at various scales, as illustrated in successive magnifications of the Mandelbrot set. This exhibition of similar patterns at increasingly smaller scales is called self-similarity, also known as expanding symmetry or unfolding symmetry; if this replication is exactly the same at every scale, as in the Menger sponge, the shape is called affine self-similar. about: McLean, Virginia-based digital identity company, founded 2010 as TroopSwap, offering ID.me wallet and verification for government, retailers and veterans. Valued at about $2 billion. Consumer-visible through discount verification at major retailers. Consumers use ID.me to verify identity and receive discounts, and agencies pay for verification. Funding of about $814 million is shown. Used by tens of millions of Americans. ID.me has more than 100 million users and works with retailers, military discount programmes and federal agencies.

San Francisco-based blockchain developer platform, founded 2017, providing APIs and node infrastructure to Web3 applications. Valued about $10 billion at peak. B2B brand. Customers are blockchain developers and crypto companies, paying subscription and usage fees. Valued at billions at its peak. Little consumer awareness. Alchemy provides node and data tools to developers and has thousands of customers including large exchanges.

wiki.title: Alchemy
wiki.text: Alchemy is an ancient branch of natural philosophy, a philosophical and protoscientific tradition that was once practised in China, India, the Muslim world, and Europe. In its Western form, alchemy is first attested in pseudepigraphical texts written in Greco-Roman Egypt during the first few centuries AD. Greek-speaking alchemists often named their craft "the Art" (τέχνη) or "Knowledge" (ἐπιστήμη), and it was often characterised as mystic (μυστική), sacred (ἱɛρά), or divine (θɛíα).

wiki.title: Alchemy (company)
wiki.text: Alchemy was an American independent global film distributor based in Los Angeles, California. The company acquired and distributed feature films, television series and specialty programming.

Revenue is subscription licences. Brand known mainly among US law firms, with some marketing activity. Founded in Utah and focused on US legal teams, with AI features added recently. Customers include large law firms and small practices. Valued over $3 billion following 2025 funding.

Reston, Virginia-based energy management and analytics company, providing building energy optimisation for retailers and enterprises. B2B. Customers are retailers, banks and real estate owners using its energy platform. B2B with little public awareness. Based in Reston, Virginia, the business is built around cloud software and sensors that reduce energy bills for multi-site customers such as retail chains and banks. The company has operated for over two decades and has a long history of working with national retailers on energy savings.

wiki.title: GridPoint
wiki.text: GridPoint is an American clean technology company based in Reston, Virginia, that provides energy management and sustainability services to enterprises and government agencies, such as electric utilities.

about: Chicago-based Azure management software firm, founded 2010, serving managed service providers with Nerdio Manager for MSP. B2B. Customers are managed service providers and enterprises. Revenue is subscription-based. B2B with limited awareness. Based in Chicago, Nerdio was founded by Vadim Vladimirskiy and Arjan Deepak. It sells software that helps MSPs deploy and cost-optimise Azure Virtual Desktop and Microsoft 365 for end customers, earning subscription fees. It raised a large growth round from Mainsail and others, and has a loyal partner base but almost no brand awareness outside IT channel circles.

wiki.title: Nerdio
wiki.text: Nerdio is an American Information Technology (IT) company headquartered in Chicago that specialises in providing virtual desktop implementations for businesses. The company provides streaming IT and IT-as-a-service to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).

Customers are financial institutions and brands. Backed by Bessemer, Hedosophia and others, and raised about $228 million. B2B with limited consumer awareness. M2P serves more than 100 financial institutions and fintechs, and its products include card programmes, lending and open banking.

FintechOS's customers include banks and insurers in Europe, and it uses AI-assisted product design tools.

Gauntlet's clients include major DeFi lenders and exchanges, and it advises them on parameters and incentives.

Einride is a Swedish freight technology company founded in 2016, known for its electric and autonomous trucks (the pod without a cab) and a freight-as-a-service platform with a logistics software layer. Customers include Maersk, Lidl, GE Appliances, Oatly and Bridgestone, and it operates in Sweden, the US and Europe. Based in Stockholm, it is backed by Nordic investors, EQT and Temasek-linked sources, and announced a SPAC merger with Legato Merger Corp. III in 2025 to list in the US. B2B but with visible branding on its futuristic trucks.

wiki.title: Einride
wiki.text: Einride AB is a Swedish transport company based in Stockholm, Sweden, specializing in electric and self-driving vehicles. The electric trucks are remotely controlled by drivers, and are notable for their lack of a driver's cab.
